Retain the upstream entity roster, variants, behavior, data, rendering, geometry, items, and interactions unless a later explicit Workbench decision changes policy.
scope: Maintain the persistence, entity render/model, entity behavior/API, egg/hatching, and dynamic item-model migrations present at frozen legacy checkpoint 63a8b46ac939d6bd48e21d4840c480361ad852ef.
Preserve 51 entity types, 48 synced variant registries with 99 definitions, legacy variant decoding, authored geometry, and exact upstream acquisition and drop ownership.
Maintain the completed Minecraft 26.2 API migration and its private, hash-verified resource-staging path without feature trimming, inert stubs, or protected-resource redistribution.

Legacy status/history narratives, generated output, caches, diagnostics, and unretained artifacts.
Runtime deployment outside the dedicated Workbench, displacement of another project's testing slot, Player Instance mutation, and protected gameplay-instance access.
Matcha-specific spawn tuning or other new gameplay policy during the preservation port.
